mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of residence / proof of current physical address dated within the last three months
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Municipal authority, tax office, or licensed utility provider in the country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / company extract for the corporate General Partner when the General Partner is a legal person
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or competent registrar in the corporate General Partner's jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial attestation; no further legalization required for EU-origin notarial instruments

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based KYC screening against PEP lists, OFAC SDN lists, UN/EU consolidated target lists, EU financial sanctions regulations, and Luxembourg national AML/CFT lists. Enhanced due diligence is required for PEPs, complex cross-border structures, and high-risk jurisdictions, applying FATF Recommendations 12, 17, 22, and 24 plus the Law of 12 November 2004 as amended. Screening must be repeated at onboarding and on an ongoing basis.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers / Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) — https://www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be written in the Latin alphabet and must include the statutory legal form suffix 'Société en Commandite Spéciale' or the abbreviation 'SCSp'. The name may be in Luxembourgish, French, German, or another language using Latin script, provided it is not misleading and complies with Luxembourg public policy. Non-Latin script names must be transliterated into Latin characters in official filings.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the RCS refuses a proposed name, the applicant may submit a written request for administrative reconsideration to the Luxembourg Business Registers within 15 days of the refusal notice. If the refusal is upheld, an administrative appeal may be filed with the Administrative Tribunal in Luxembourg City within three months of notification. A name reservation is not renewable; after the 30-day negative certificate expires, the name is released and a fresh name clearance application must be filed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is accepted for an SCSp only when a licensed full-service domiciliation agent in Luxembourg provides a physical registered office, receives and forwards official correspondence, and maintains statutory books and records. For the declared business scope of tax structuring and transfer pricing advisory, a virtual-only office is not permissible and a physical office with actual economic substance must be maintained.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low quantified risk: approximately 10% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection for a standard low-risk consultancy entity; the likelihood rises to 45% where a PEP is a UBO, where cross-border related-party services are invoiced, or where substance indicators are weak.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended; SCSp-specific provisions under Articles 904-1 to 904-7 introduced by the Law of 12 July 2013; Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies and the Luxembourg Business Registers
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) — Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Partnership Agreement (Contrat de Société / Statuts) and Certificate of Registration with the RCS
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum legal capital or paid-up capital requirement for a Société en Commandite Spéciale (SCSp); capital is freely determined in the partnership agreement and may comprise cash, in-kind contributions, or industry contributions without escrow account rules
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: By unanimous written resolution of the board of managers of the SCSp and with the consent of the general partner, the following resolutions are adopted. First, the partnership agreement is approved as the constitutional instrument of the SCSp, and the object as set out therein, concerning cross-border tax structuring and transfer pricing advisory, is ratified. Second, subscriptions of the limited partners, including any contributions in kind, are accepted and recorded. Third, the registered office is fixed at the address stated in the agreement, within Luxembourg. Fourth, the general partner is confirmed as sole managing entity and its authorized signatories are appointed. Fifth, the authorized signatories are instructed to complete RCS registration, publication, and all applicable regulatory filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – online name database
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an initial availability check of the proposed partnership name in the RCS database and the RESA publication archive. If distinct and not misleading, file a reservation request via the LBR online portal before incorporation. Submit one word or an extract of the proposed corporate name; avoid terms suggesting a regulated financial undertaking unless a license is held.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for conflict or public-policy grounds, submit a revised name with a comparative search certificate within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary optional / private deed under LSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the statuts in French or German. Include firm name, object, registered office, duration, identity of the general partner, subscription amounts, allocation and management provisions. Have all partners and the general partner execute the agreement. If contributions include immovable property, a notarial deed is required; otherwise private signatures suffice. Arrange a certified translation if the filing language differs.
required_dossiers: Identification documents of all partners and general partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where an application is rejected for incompleteness, rectify the omitted clauses and re-execute an amended version before filing with the RCS.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Formation Dossier with the RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online formation form on lbr.lu, upload the executed partnership agreement and declarations, and pay the filing fee. Confirm each partner's and manager's identity and capacity. Upon validation, receive the registration certificate with the RCS number. The filing is automatically sent for publication in RESA.
required_dossiers: Declarations of non-bankruptcy and authorization from managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a query, respond through the LBR portal within 15 days; amend the document and re-submit the affected page or declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Official Electronic Gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – RESA (Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The RCS transmits an extract of the registration for publication. Verify that the published extract accurately contains the name, registered office, object, partners' liability, and managers' names. No separate user action is normally required, but any correction request must be filed within 15 days of publication.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If incorrect information is published, submit an application for rectification to the RCS, attaching the authenticated certificate and amended resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, VAT and Social Security Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD); Administration de l'Enregistrement; Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Use the RCS number to obtain a Luxembourg national identification number (matricule) and register for corporate tax and VAT via the guichet.lu portal. Register any employees with the Joint Social Security Centre. The partnership may apply for a VAT number and electronic filing credentials. For the SCSp, the tax declaration is filed on behalf of the partnership and the partners are assessed separately unless an opacity election is made.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ACD delays the matricule or VAT number, follow up through the taxpayer portal and provide a notarized or apostilled copy of the partnership agreement.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy, Directorate General for Industry and Services – Luxembourg
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'établissement (Business Establishment Permit) and municipal operating authorization

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: No mandatory EIA Report; activity is a category '0' office/service consultancy under the amended environmental impact assessment law, subject only to registration for applicable waste declarations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process discharges. Office wastewater must comply with municipal sewer use regulations; waste electrical and electronic equipment must be handed to authorized WEEE collectors under national transposition of EU directives; indoor air quality aligns with WHO guidelines for volatile organic compounds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Luxembourg fire and rescue corps (CGDIS), structural load clearance from the Building Department (Service des Bâtiments), and occupational health certificate from the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Luxembourg Inland Revenue (Administration des contributions directes - ACD) for direct taxes; Registration Duties, Estates and VAT Authority (Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA - AEDT) for VAT and indirect taxes. Digital services are accessible through the Guichet.lu portal and MyGuichet electronic filing system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Entities incorporated or registered with the Luxembourg Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS) automatically obtain a Luxembourg national identification number (NIF). Foreign entities establishing a permanent establishment or carrying on taxable activities must apply to the AEDT for a VAT identification number and to the ACD for income tax registration, generally using Luxembourg standard forms or MyGuichet. Non-resident entities may need to appoint a Luxembourg tax representative for VAT purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The SCSp is fiscally transparent by law and cannot be classified as opaque for Luxembourg direct tax purposes except as explicitly provided under bilateral tax treaties or EU law. There is no U.S.-style check-the-box election. The SCSp may, however, elect to be part of a Luxembourg VAT group where all members satisfy the control and integration requirements. Partners may also make joint protective filings under EU hybrid mismatch rules to align the tax treatment of the partnership in cross-border structures.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Luxembourg Value Added Tax, implemented under the EU VAT Directive and the Luxembourg VAT Law of 12 February 1979)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover for Luxembourg-established taxable persons after which VAT registration becomes mandatory; non-resident suppliers have no registration threshold and must register on their first taxable supply in Luxembourg.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg does not currently mandate real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping for VAT invoices. B2B and B2C e-invoicing is permitted provided the authenticity of origin and integrity of content are guaranteed. Electronic invoicing is mandatory for B2G supplies, with PEPPOL-compliant formats accepted. No country-wide API-based clearance system or digital fiscal stamping requirement is in force.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The supply of goods is zero-rated for Luxembourg VAT when the goods are physically exported to a destination outside the European Union, provided the seller retains sufficient evidence of export within a statutory time limit. Services supplied to non-EU business customers are generally outside the scope of Luxembourg VAT where the place of supply is the customer's jurisdiction; services supplied to non-EU non-taxable persons may be zero-rated in defined circumstances. The exporter must keep proof of export and the foreign status of the customer.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or air waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate or evidence of payment from abroad
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export transactions are subject to enhanced documentary audit review. If zero-rating is claimed without genuine physical exports or corroborative documentation, the Luxembourg tax authorities may retrospectively claw back the input VAT deducted and issue an assessment for the unpaid VAT plus default interest at the statutory monthly rate of 0.6%. Wilful fraud may trigger administrative penalties of up to 100% of the tax evaded, and criminal tax fraud sanctions may be imposed, including fines up to EUR 25,000 and/or imprisonment in aggravated cases.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (Central Bank of Luxembourg; BCL), acting as a member of the Eurosystem and as the competent authority for monetary policy and external statistics; the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) supervises banking conduct, AML/CFT compliance, and fintech/EMI licensing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg observes full convertibility for both current and capital account transactions under the EU Treaty provisions on free movement of capital and payments. Profit remittance by an SCSp is not subject to exchange-control approval or conversion requirements. Practical hurdles are limited to EU sanctions screening, AML/KYC documentation, economic substance disclosure, and accurate balance-of-payments statistical reporting; no distinct capital-control licensing regime applies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender rule or mandatory conversion ratio applies in Luxembourg. Export receipts may be retained in any freely convertible currency and used directly for cross-border disbursements. Reporting obligations arise only under the European System of Central Banks statistical framework and EU customs/BOP data collection rules; no central bank approval is required for repatriation or conversion.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-moderate with legal constraints. An EU-licensed electronic money institution (EMI) may passport into Luxembourg and offer payment accounts, but an offshore or non-EU EMI is generally not acceptable for institutional capital flows. CSSF-regulated banks require an SCSp to hold its core treasury accounts at a fully licensed credit institution in Luxembourg or in the EEA; EMIs can be used only for ancillary payment execution with segregated funds safeguarding.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is legally possible under Luxembourg AML law when CSSF-compliant digital identity verification (eIDAS-qualified electronic signature or regulated video identification) is used. In practice, major Luxembourg banks require at least one director or ultimate beneficial owner to attend an in-person interview at account opening for a foreign-managed SCSp. The SCSp must also demonstrate a substantive Luxembourg nexus through the general partner or appointed governing person and a registered seat.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity because SCSp is a limited partnership without legal personality and has limited-partner confidentiality.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified partnership agreement, register of partners, declaration of beneficial ownership filed with the Luxembourg Business Registers (RBE), capital contribution proof, and clear identification of all direct and indirect UBOs holding more than 25%.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border tax structuring consultancy revenue pattern triggers source-of-funds review, especially with credit-card receipts and intercompany fee flows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed engagement letters, detailed invoices, timesheets, fee calculation reports, VAT returns, tax residence certificate, professional indemnity insurance, and clean source-of-wealth statements from foreign shareholders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived lack of economic substance due to no physical office or employees in Luxembourg.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease agreement for a registered office or managed office, employment contracts, payroll filings with the Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS), statutory board meeting minutes, and an operational schedule evidencing management decisions and filing obligations performed in Luxembourg.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions exposure arising from non-resident partners or complex offshore investor chains.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Group structure chart, UBO passports, sanctions screening results against EU/UN/OFSI/OFAC lists, negative media checks, corporate registry extracts, and a documented AML/CFT compliance manual.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be routed through regulated bank wire protocols: SWIFT MT103 for non-EEA transfers and SEPA Credit Transfer for euro-denominated transfers from EEA jurisdictions. The remittance instruction must state the precise central-bank statistical purpose code identifying the flow as an equity contribution to partnership capital rather than a service or trade payment. Supporting documents should include the signed capital commitment, the partner subscription certificate, the SCSp partnership agreement, a capital account statement, and beneficial ownership declarations. Third-party funding and cryptocurrency transmission are prohibited.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlement from the Luxembourg SCSp treasury should use SEPA Credit Transfer for euro payments within the EEA and SWIFT MT103 for non-EEA or foreign-currency payments. Commercial letters of credit issued under UCP600 are permissible for goods-related cross-border settlements where the supplier requires documentary security. Banks will verify the underlying contract, invoice, and trade documentation; there is no exchange-control or surrender restriction on outgoing funds.

stage_5.statutory_deliverable: UBO Annual Confirmation - annual re-confirmation of the beneficial-owner declaration of the SCSp in the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)
stage_5.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs - RBE), administered by the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
stage_5.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month following the anniversary of the initial RBE registration of the SCSp (anniversary cycle); any change in beneficial ownership from a partnership-interest transfer must be filed within 30 days of the transfer
stage_5.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of EUR 250 - EUR 1,250 (approx. USD 270 - USD 1,350) per infringement; criminal sanctions for the general partner or managers of EUR 500 - EUR 25,000 (approx. USD 540 - USD 27,000) and/or imprisonment of 8 days to 6 months; the RBE officially marks the entity as non-compliant (visible to counterparties, banks and obliged entities).

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (17% corporate income tax + 7% solidarity surcharge + up to 6.75% Luxembourg City municipal business tax; before reductions for qualifying pass-through income)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The SCSp is fiscally transparent by default and is not itself within the charge to Luxembourg corporate income tax; partners are taxable in their own hands. No general corporate tax holiday applies to fee-based consultancy income. Participation exemption may reduce qualifying dividends and capital gains to 0%; the IP regime exempts 80% of qualifying IP income. Wealth tax and municipal business tax may apply where the SCSp has a Luxembourg permanent establishment or carrying on business through an establishment in Luxembourg.
